applyScheduled: The environment will be prepared on the next start; files in the channel are kept
how1: Cloud and your own devices use the same scripts, so the environment must support their commands
how2: The setup script runs in the channel directory and the startup script in the task's code directory. Both use Bash, each for at most 30 minutes, with the environment's current permissions. Environment variables go to both scripts and the AI teammate; an export in a script doesn't carry to the next step. Tools can be installed to $HOME/.local/bin
how3: For the setup script, $HOME is this project's shared tool directory on the machine, so tools are installed once and later channels use them. The startup script and the AI teammate have each channel's own $HOME, so don't write anything channel-specific in the setup script
intro: Installs tools for channels and project dependencies when task code is prepared. Channels in the project share this setup; General uses the base environment and helps fix environment problems
logNote: Only the last 32 KB of log is shown; the full log is in the channel's $HOME
roomNote: Files in the channel are kept. A channel that is running applies the setup after the current run ends
saveNote: Saving affects only new channels; existing channels keep their setup
saved: Saved. New channels use this setup; existing channels keep theirs
setupHint: Installs tools such as Python and Node. Runs once per project on each machine, and again when a new setup is applied
startupHint: Runs each time a task's working directory is created or reopened, installing that branch's dependencies
title: Scripts and environment variables
varInvalid: Variable names can't be empty or repeated
varsHint: Project members and AI teammates can see these values. Don't store passwords or API keys here
